packet.title: EXI header options document
packet.summary: Writes and reads the options document of the EXI header, with the schema-informed grammar of the EXI options schema, and the cookie.

body.p: After 8.9. EXI 1.0, section 5 and Appendix C (the options schema).

item.p: Mechanism: src/exi_header.c; the options schema compiled from text embedded in the library and its grammar built by 8.9, once per encoder or decoder.
Done when: the decode and encode checks of the header-options and schema-header sets pass and are in the ratchet.
